revision: S3 / R2, 12HP (2026-11-20, clock link: CLK OUT J6 / CLK IN J7; the 10HP S2 / R1 layout is kept, with 5.05 mm of board and panel added on each side, so the jack grid and the USB-C stay centred; link parts placed and routed by hand, the U4 clock buffer group and two ADC bridges re-routed to pass the four link lines, clock_link.routing). Two boards: carrier (jack board, 4 layers) and MCU board (4 layers, unchanged) stacked on the carrier F side on 2.54 mm strips, as modules/usb-audio. Both boards are placed and routed by hand: tools/build_layout.py is not rerun. Two M3x10 F-F hex standoffs MS1/MS2 beside the MCU board (mount_standoffs), coaxial panel holes H20/H21.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY, for the carrier, the MCU board and the panel. The carrier F side faces the panel; the MCU board sits on the carrier F side with its own F side facing the panel, so both KiCad top views equal the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Doepfer A-100 12HP: 60.6 mm wide; holes X12.58 (the Doepfer X7.5 moved 1HP right) and X12.58 + 8 x 5.08 = 53.22 (= Doepfer X7.5 + (HP - 3) x 5.08), both on the 2HP case spacer grid (mechanical/case/tools/build_case.py). Skiff rails: clear Y8.0..120.5.
hp_decision: 12HP (user 2026-11-19: clock link as modules/multi-mix, 12HP if needed, every socket centred). 10HP was the S2 size (fit study in docs/research.md section 5); its free pockets on B (17 x 7, 10 x 6, 8 x 6 mm) do not take two 2x5 headers and 21 link parts. At 12HP each side gains a 5.05 mm strip: the 2x5 headers stand upright in the strips beside the IN jacks and the link logic sits above them.

main_pcb.note: 59.6 x 110.0 mm, 0.5 mm inside the 60.6 mm panel each side and 1.25 mm inside the rail gap at each end. Held by the 14 jack nuts and the two standoffs; the MCU board hangs on it. All SMD on B (single-sided assembly).

mcu_pcb.note: 29.0 x 29.55 mm: the modules/usb-audio MCU board outline (R1/R2) and strip/USB-C positions, centred on the panel. All SMD on F (one assembly side), facing the panel. Unchanged by the 12HP carrier (same board, same files).

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear (as modules/usb-audio).
stack_Z_mm.usbc_note: As modules/usb-audio: the USB-C mouth must be no more than ~0.3 mm behind the panel front or the plug cannot seat; HRO TYPE-C-31-D-15 (8.8 mm) on a 1.6 mm MCU board on 2.5 mm header plastic puts it 1.3 mm proud of the 1.6 mm FR4 panel.

layout_note: User brief 2026-11-06: USB-C at the top (as modules/usb-audio); three columns, IN 1-6 in two rows of three, OUT 1-8 in three rows below, reading order; the ninth spot (bottom right) is empty on the panel and holds the power header on the back. 12HP (2026-11-19): the same grid, centred: columns X12.05 / X30.3 / X48.55 (12.05 mm from both panel edges, 18.25 mm pitch); rows Y46.3 / 62.25 / 78.2 / 94.15 / 110.1 (15.95 mm pitch). The 5.05 mm strips left and right of the 10HP layout hold the clock-link headers and logic (clock_link).

usb_slot.note: Obround NPTH slot for the receptacle shell (8.94 x 3.16 mm) with ~0.27 mm clearance a side, as modules/usb-audio; the shell passes through and stands 1.3 mm proud. User 2026-11-19: extended 1.5 mm downwards (was 9.5 x 3.7 at Y16; top edge kept at Y14.15, bottom Y17.85 -> Y19.35), so it is now 0.27 mm above and ~1.77 mm below the shell. 2026-11-23 (fab review of modules/32bit, same slot): 9.5 -> 11.0 mm wide, same centre, top and bottom edge. At 9.5 the slot's R2.6 ends cut 0.034 mm into the shell's rounded upper corners (R1.58, nominal); at 11.0 the end circles sit over the shell's end circles, 0.27 mm clear round the upper half.

reserved_zones_mcu.what: U101 LQFP-64 (modules/usb-audio R2 spot: centre X30.3 Y31.75)

back_side_parts.band: Eurorack power in the empty ninth jack spot (bottom right), vertical, pin 1 (-12 V) at the bottom row. THT, B side

SWD (WCH-LinkE): pin 1 +3V3 at the top (Y19.1), B side, top-left beside J2 (SWDIO/SWCLK on J2.3/J2.4), below the MS1 standoff (moved down 5.1 with the standoff batch); tails on F clear of the MCU board
RESET, B side, below J4 (NRST on J2.5)
BOOT, B side, below RESET (BOOT0 on J2.6)

power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the OUT6 jack tails, 2.5 mm above B (SMD under it must stay below 2.5 mm).

mount_standoffs.hardware: per standoff: 1 x M3 F-F hex standoff 10 mm, 2 x M3x6 pan/button head (ISO 7380), as modules/4mix. Not M3x8: two M3x8 would meet inside a through-tapped 10 mm standoff.
mount_standoffs.note: User 2026-11-08: two M3 hex standoffs at the top beside the USB-C port so pushing the plug does not move the carrier (modules/usb-audio needed a printed brace); the first try beside the strips at Y35.4 was rejected (user: on the top, around the USB port). Carrier F to panel rear is 10 mm (stack_Z_mm), so each standoff is coaxial: carrier hole = panel hole. Mirror images about the panel centre (10HP: X25.25, as high / far out as the 1 mm edge keep-out allowed; 12HP 2026-11-19: kept with the routed copper at X10.05 / X50.55, 10.05 mm from each panel edge, the new 5.05 mm strips are outside them), level with the USB-C (Y16): the hex (corners R3.18) clears the MCU board outline (X15.8..44.8) by >= 2.5 mm, the panel bolt heads (R2.75) sit between the rail band and the IN labels. No F copper inside R3.3 and no B copper inside R3.5; In1/In2 planes are cut by the NPTH only. Carrier footprints: board-only, empty Reference + MechanicalID MS1/MS2 (shared parity: mechanical), NPTH 3.2, F courtyard R3.3, B courtyard R3.4 (M3 head R2.85), 3D model standoff-m3x10.step from modules/4mix. Placed on the routed carrier by research/route/c_b30_standoffs_top.py: J4 SWD down 5.1, SW1/SW2 down, Y1 right 1.0 with C29 upright, C28 to the +3V3_C via by J2; buck core (L1 U2 C6 C7 C8 R3 R4 R5 R20) down 2.3 with its copper, C9/C10 left 0.5, C5 under C10, C4 left of L1, R13 upright by J3, FB2 below the core.

kicad_origin_note: 12HP: the origin moved 5.05 mm left (was [100.0, 50.0] at 10HP) instead of moving the routed copper, so every KiCad sheet coordinate of the 10HP carrier, MCU board and panel is unchanged and every panel-frame X in this file is the 10HP value + 5.05.

clock_link.note: S3 (user 2026-11-19): the modules/multi-mix clock link, same circuit, pinout and ribbon. Two unshrouded 2x5 2.54 mm pin headers upright on B in the 12HP side strips beside the IN 1-3 jack row, level with each other; pin 1 at the top in the column nearer the panel right edge (as modules/multi-mix J6/J7). CLK OUT on the left edge, CLK IN on the right edge, so a clock slave sits to the left of its master. Not keyed (a 2x5 box header is 8.8 mm wide and does not fit the 5.05 mm strip beside the jack bodies): safety is the pinout (docs/research.md section 8).
clock_link.idc_note: 10-way IDC socket 7.6 x 17.78 mm centred on the pins, 2.5 mm above B: inside the 60.6 mm panel width (0.87 mm each side). Its overhang past the pin rows covers only 0603 parts (0.55 mm high, 1.9 mm under the socket): R82 / R72 above J6, R70 and the top pad row of U12 (SC-70, 1.1 mm high) below it; R75 / R83 above J7 and R77 / R78 below it. J6: 0.69 mm below SW2 BOOT. The ribbon leaves sideways towards the neighbouring module.
